consequence.statement: Inbound requests the service has not seen/processed are now automatically retried/reset by default; this can be reverted by setting ENABLE_INBOUND_RETRY_POLICY to false.
consequence.remediation: Set ENABLE_INBOUND_RETRY_POLICY to false to revert.

assertion.statement: Istio 1.24.0 adds a retry policy for inbound requests that automatically resets requests the service has not seen/processed; setting ENABLE_INBOUND_RETRY_POLICY to false reverts it.
